text:
Type: chrome architect floor lamp
Use: reading and task light beside an armchair, sofa or desk; living room, home office, study
Style: industrial, modern, retro
Materials: polished chrome-plated steel shade, jointed arms and pole, round metal base
Colors: polished silver chrome, black joints
Shape: small bell shade on a long two-part jointed arm with tension cables, tall slim pole, round flat base, mechanical drafting lamp look, light and open
Feel: sleek, focused, studious, crisp
Goes with: dark wood, leather, white or grey walls, black accents; industrial, modern or retro studies and living rooms

product.name: ANTIFONI
product.description: You can easily direct the light where you want it because the lamp arm and head are adjustable.
